tools.name: check_demand
tools.description: Start here. Check whether people have asked for a product and could not buy it. Returns matching exNiche gaps at summary level (verdict, score band, class, trend, source counts, one linked ask) and records your ask as one AI agent search. 1 credit. Never send personal details or synthetic asks.

tools.name: list_gaps
tools.description: List the exNiche gap ledger with filters. detail=summary costs 1 credit per call; detail=full adds exact scores, all linked asks and requirements for 10 credits per scored row. Scores mean 'worth a closer look', not verified demand.

tools.name: get_gap
tools.description: Get one gap by id or slug. detail=summary costs 1 credit; detail=full (exact score parts, every ask with link and attribution, requirements, 8-week ask counts) costs 100 credits. Unscored leads only return summary.

tools.name: get_dossier
tools.description: Full dossier for a scored gap: product-by-product checks, live closest products, supplier candidates and a suggested spec. Needs a workspace key. Unlocking costs 19,000 credits once per account; an already unlocked dossier costs 0. Ask the user before unlocking.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search recorded retail listings across stores using explicit budget, currency, size, color and stock filters. 1 credit. Returns ranked purchase links with observed availability; unknown facts stay unknown. Misses may be saved as agent observations, never verified human demand.

tools.name: report_not_found
tools.description: Free. Report a genuine shopper mismatch after a search. Do not send synthetic reports or personal details. Response states whether the agent observation was saved; it is not verified human demand.

tools.name: get_setup_and_upgrade_links
tools.description: Free. Return exNiche install commands for MCP clients, the agent guide, and the signup and prepaid-credit links to hand the user when free credits run out. Free: 1,000 credits a month. Credits: A$10 = 10,000. No automatic charges.
